## Indirect cost rate — decide this once

Federal awards let an organization without a negotiated rate elect the **10%
de minimis** rate on modified total direct costs. Two things follow:

1. Elect it. Declining indirect costs does not make an application more
   competitive; it makes the organization absorb real overhead it cannot afford
   at this budget size.
2. If a negotiated indirect cost rate agreement is ever obtained, record it
   here: [[PLACEHOLDER: NICRA rate and agreement date, if any]]

## Budget narrative rules

- Every line traces to a program activity described elsewhere in the application.
- Show the arithmetic: "0.25 FTE Program Coordinator at $52,000 = $13,000,"
  not "$13,000."
- Match requirements: check each solicitation. Note here which pipeline grants
  require match: [[PLACEHOLDER]]
- **Cash flow:** most federal awards reimburse after spending. At a
  $300,000 budget, a large cost-reimbursement award creates a real payroll
  float problem. Before accepting one, confirm a line of credit or bridge
  source: [[PLACEHOLDER: what covers the gap]]
